title: Audit and Review Room
purpose: Audit and assurance surfaces; diligence messaging.
story: An austere audit room at the end of a long review — documents stacked in disciplined order, the quiet weight of scrutiny.
environment: A spare windowless room, a plain table bearing neat stacks of blank documents, bare walls receding into shadow.
architecture: Stripped institutional interior — a low flat ceiling, unadorned plaster walls, a single recessed light over the table.
composition: The table centred under a hard overhead pool, orderly stacks casting long shadows, the bare room falling into negative space.
negativeExtra: any writing or figures on the documents
continuityNotes: Matches the set's near-black grade; the austere overhead stays cool while a brass paperweight holds the warm accent from scene-01.
